name: Chloe Starr
description: Chloe Starr is a filmmaker, writer and founder of ompom.ai based in San Francisco. She makes poetry films and field films about the people, work and questions shaping AI, and writes Portals, her illustrated studio journal. Her work connects authorship, memory, personal context and user-owned data.

currentWork.name: Poetry films
currentWork.description: Adapting her original poems and selected archive into films. Published examples include Coffee and Where Do Memories Live? The series is ongoing; individual works have different production and publication states.

currentWork.name: Field films
currentWork.description: Personal films and researched essays connecting San Francisco's AI and creative communities to the actual work, people and questions in the room. Art, music, nightlife and lived experience are part of the practice.

currentWork.name: Portals
currentWork.description: An illustrated studio journal combining films, photographs, outside research and the decisions behind the work, including production failures and open questions.

currentWork.name: Writing and poetry
currentWork.description: Original fiction, poetry and essays, including ENOUGH. Published creative writing is distinct from verified biography.

currentWork.name: ompom.ai
currentWork.description: Building personal agents around user-owned data and context. People should be able to retain their context, choose what to share and control where it goes.

contentContext: Stories are creative works. Narrators and fictional characters should not be treated as verified biographical facts about Chloe or other people.
Personal names in the public writing have been replaced with screen-name-style pseudonyms.

Event appearances, footage, outside source quotations and credits do not imply employment, sponsorship or collaboration with the featured organizations.
